dataList.content:
<What will happen to them?>
<他们两人身上会发生什么事？>

Erlking Heathcliff, once he kills Heathcliff of this world for good... will leap over to other worlds to slay other versions of Heathcliff.
成功消灭这个世界希斯克利夫先生的魔王希斯克利夫……将会跨越所有世界，去消灭其他的希斯克利夫吧……

If Catherine's summoning succeeds... she will become another Catherine who leaps between every world, creating more Catherines like herself.
如果凯瑟琳的召唤成功……她也会跨越所有世界，去创造和自己一样的凯瑟琳。

<... To what end?>
<那么，这一切最终会变成怎样……？>

... To an end where there is nothing but the silence and the lamentation of both Heathcliff and Catherine. Wouldn't you agree?
最终……大概只剩下希斯克利夫与凯瑟琳……他们二人的惨叫了吧。

<There's a sound... coming from my device... >
<从我的终端里……传来了声音……>

Dante.
但丁。

I see that you write a diary of your own.
你也在写日记呢。

I wouldn't call it a diary. It's not like I record what happens every day in here...
准确来说并不是日记。因为我没写下每一天发生的事情……

That counts as a diary still.
那也是日记。

It is a record of your life.
因为这是你人生的记录。

Then... I suppose it is.
那……也可以这么说吧。

Catherine.
凯瑟琳。

Just before the break of dawn, during the quietest hours of the day... I would write in my diary.
每逢一天中最为静谧的黎明时分，我便会提笔写下日记。

Especially on days when I suffered from fevers. I could not bear to keep going without vomiting every fault of mine on a piece of paper.
尤其是那些我被高烧折磨的日子。如果不把我的全部过错都倾吐在纸上，我简直无法忍受。

I was always honest with my diary.
我将一切都如实记录在日记上了。

But...
但是……

It seems that I could never be honest anywhere else.
看起来在日记本之外，我没能坦诚心扉。

While I hid my true feelings from the ones I loved... while refusing to communicate myself... I became angry at those who couldn't understand me.
明明自己就藏着对心上人的心意……却又对他人不理解我的心意而感到恼火。

Heathcliff shall never know.
希斯克利夫永远不会知道吧。

He will never know how much I...
我有多么……

How much I...
多么……

No. I have to know.
不，我必须知道。

Heathcliff? How did you...?
希斯克利夫？你为什么会在这里？

I needed a lot of courage to get here.
为了到达此处，我需要很大的勇气。

Catherine.
凯瑟琳。

It’s all so easy for you. For you to topple me...
你能轻而易举地将我撕碎……

For you to ground me up until I'm nothing.
让我变得一无是处。

I was so happy whenever you came to visit me. A single glance from you in my direction could brighten my entire day. You were almost like a calamity.
你来见我的时候，我是如此地欣喜。你的注视，能让我的整日都充满幸福。简直就像灾难一般。

And I have always, always...
但我却对那狂风骤雨般的灾难……

... always loved that very calamity that swept over me like the tempest, Catherine.
无时无刻不心怀爱意，凯瑟琳。

Thank you. For having the courage.
谢谢你，能鼓起勇气。

Finally, our hearts...
我们的心意……

... are no longer broken apart.
终于不再相悖。

Dante. May I borrow your diary for a moment?
但丁。我能暂借你的日记一用吗？

The Golden Bough has far more impressive powers than any of us could have ever imagined.
金枝的力量比我们所能想象的要大得多。

What powers...?
什么……？

It has been bringing your own wishes to reality, has it not?
迄今为止，它不是一直在实现你们的愿望吗？

So...
因此……

The key to my Heathcliff's happiness...
能让我的希斯克利夫获得幸福的方法……

... is in your diary.
应该就在你的日记之中。

So I...
所以我……

... looked down at the screen of the device I carried. Something I used to think was nothing but a tool for recording things.
我盯着自己那原本以为只是用于记录的终端画面。

Thank you so much for being the first one to talk, Heathcliff.
谢谢你先说出口了，希斯克利夫。

I don't love every Heathcliff in every world.
我爱的不是所有世界中的希斯克利夫……

I love you. As you are now.
我只爱此刻的你。
